title: First veterinarian completes Mizzou’s innovative mixed animal internship
summary_en: Sam Hoover is showing how a new approach to training veterinarians can strengthen the workforce, expand access to care and prepare veterinarians for the demands of mixed animal practice in rural communities.

title: Mizzou provides nursing students with hands-on experience beyond the hospital

title: Mizzou innovation speeds up detection of deadly tick-borne disease
summary_en: Thanks to university researchers, Rocky Mountain spotted fever can now be detected in just 40 minutes, leading to earlier treatment.
